author: Jerseys
body:
My name is Dynamohh and I was a dangerous player in this nice, loving community! I caused destruction in this community. I was banned for hacking, which I did...I regret it. I'm a sorry for what I have done, I acted like I was a king however I was just a boy on the computer causing problems for every single person in this community! I hacked because I thought I would leave this server and never come back, I was wrong...I alted for a week, and then I thought to myself its pretty useless, so I went into the shadows...

 Now here I am, regretting what I have done... I know what I have done and its bad however, I have changed in these last 3 months!


I have learnt my mistakes, and I have learnt from all of them. I'v been bad since I joined, but finally, I have thought what I have done and I have looked back, at myself.  

My mistakes, my actions... I know what I have done, but i have seriously changed. I have learnt to control myslef...

Thank you for your time <3

title: Appealing For My Stupidity!

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your infraction. I trust that you did actualy change. Please don't make me regret my decision. I'd like to stress that if you're banned again, you have 0 chance of appealing.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
